## RE:volution Mod v1.3.1

Architecture baseline for future world, realm, location and fixed-mob changes. This branch prepares the release for review; publication and Minecraft runtime acceptance remain separate steps.

### Added
- An explicit server composition root with constructor-injected services and repository ports.
- Separate definition, runtime state, persistence projection, application service, transport, command and client responsibilities.
- Architecture guards, negative guard tests and mirrored test packages.
- Mongo document/encoding contracts, byte goldens for all eight registered packet DTOs, resource/payment/combat service checks and whitelist migration tests.
- An architecture contract and runtime checklist for future changes.

### Fixed
- Business operations no longer live inside request packet DTOs and handlers.
- Shared Mongo ownership replaces independent clients in static managers; shutdown releases server state, listeners, request cooldowns and the connection.
- Client registration and initialization are isolated from common/server classes.
- Builds no longer depend on a committed absolute Windows JDK path.

### Other
- Forge 1.12.2, Java 8, gameplay formulas, economy, legacy action strings, IDs 0-7, Mongo schema and optional-client support are preserved.
- Resource-pack mechanics, namespace, paths, fallback and reload are unchanged.
- Realms, locations, fixed-mob progression and new reward distribution mechanics are not implemented here.
- The unused ServerInit bootstrap and unregistered BalancePacket were removed; registered balance packet ID 1 remains unchanged.
- Local validation runs clean build, 21 standalone Java regression runners and architecture guards. Live MongoDB/Minecraft acceptance remains required.

### Download
When released, download `RE-volution-1.3.1.jar` and use the same version on the server and modded clients. Rune textures continue to ship separately in the [RE:volution Resource Pack](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack).

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1
